messages:
leah: FYI security advisory: automated scan surfaced several IAM trust policies that allow any OIDC audience (aud='*') to assume roles used by ingestion and metrics services. This increases risk of cross-tenant token replay. We need an emergency lockdown and a short coordinated roll-out. 36h remediation SLA. :rotating_light:

sec-bot: iam-scan v1.4 reported 5 affected roles at 2026-03-22T20:05Z. Summary: accounts=[prod,staging,partnerx], roles=[ingest/connector, metrics/relay, ext/metrics-relay, shared/ingest-bridge, partnerx/analytics-role]. Severity=high.

tom: Can you paste the exact IAM statements? Want to quickly validate whether it's StringLike or StringEquals missing.

leah: main issue is Condition: StringLike tokens.example.com:aud '*' or missing condition altogether. Example bad snippet:```json
{
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Principal":{"Federated":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/tokens.example.com"},
  "Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
  "Condition":{ "StringLike": { "tokens.example.com:aud": "*" } }
}
```

marco: I kicked off a targeted grep across org: `./infra/tools/iam-audit/find_wildcard_aud.sh --org prod,staging,partnerx --output ./tmp/wildcards.json` 12 results: 5 unique roles. Uploading list to infra/iam/wildcards-20260322.json

infra-automation: I can open auto-fix PRs for straightforward roles (single-statement trusts). Flagging roles that require manual review (multi-condition or external conditions). Using template: infra/iam/PRs/oidc-aud-lockdown-template.md

oncall-sre: I've placed an inbound WAF rule to reject AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity calls where aud is missing or aud == '*' from tokens.example.com. This is temporary to reduce blast radius. Monitoring for pipeline failures.

leah: Remediation checklist (owners assigned):
1) Replace wildcard aud with explicit audience(s) that match our IdP issuer and tenant path. Owner: tom.
2) Rotate client secrets / JWKs at the IdP and request partner-provided keys rotated if partner-managed. Owner: jesse (partner comms).
3) Revoke existing tokens where the IdP supports token revocation or reduce token lifetime. Owner: partner contacts / oncall-sre for prod impact.
4) Run verify script: `infra/tools/iam-audit/verify_no_wildcard_aud.py --report ./reports/2026-03-22` Owner: marco.
5) Post an incident summary + lessons learned after containment. Owner: leah.

tom: I'll start PRs to lock aud to the expected issuer URI. Example safe condition:```json
{
  "Condition":{
    "StringEquals":{
      "tokens.example.com:aud":"https://tokens.example.com/oidc/partnerx"
    }
  }
}
```

marco: created PR infra/iam#4891 for partnerx/analytics-role, infra/iam#4892 for shared/ingest-bridge. Both include tests that assert no '*' auds.

infra-automation: auto-PR process opened changes for 3 roles. Two roles failed auto-fix due to complex, concatenated conditions; assigned to tom and leah for manual patch.

oncall-sre: Observed a small spike in 403s from downstream ingest for ~2m after the WAF rule; rollbacks not needed. Impact minimal.

leah: partnerx notified. Asked them to rotate JWKs and enforce token revocation. They confirmed rotation scheduled within 4h.

tom: After manual edits, run: `python infra/tools/iam-audit/verify_no_wildcard_aud.py --roles ...` and paste verification output here.

marco: verify script run: no remaining wildcard auds in prod/staging/partnerx. Output uploaded: s3://redwood-infra-scans/2026-03-22/verify_no_wildcard_aud.txt

leah: Good work. We'll keep WAF block in place until partners confirm rotation + we see stable telemetry for 24h. I'll draft an internal advisory for leadership and CS to summarize partner impact and mitigation steps. :lock:

sec-bot: ticket created: SEC-2026-115, severity=high, target-remediation=2026-03-24T20:00Z. Notifying compliance and legal for any potential data exposure assessment.

marco: adding short runbook notes to infra/runbooks/oidc-aud-hardening.md with rollback steps and verification commands.

leah: closing updates here — ping me directly for help on manual condition merges. We'll run a post-incident review after 72h.

oncall-sre: ack, will watch metrics and escalate if any consumer errors rise above threshold.

tom: ack, patching in flight.

infra-automation: all auto PRs merged and CI green.

leah: thanks team. Follow-up advisory will be posted in #all-hands later today."
